payload.title: Design a shared customer lifecycle for hosted products and dedicated accounts
payload.description: Discovery proposal only; no implementation authorized yet. Use Cyclotron as the first hosted product and inspect Chatticus waitlist, email-confirmation and invite APIs for reuse. Separate contacts/opportunities from organizations, subscriptions, deployments and entitlements. Define acquisition attribution, booking, account activation, credit ledger, accepted-job deadlines, usage alerts, check-ins, renewal, export and cancellation. Reuse established identity/payment/calendar/email services; build only Anthus-specific orchestration and reusable UI. Extract an open package after a second working consumer; keep customer records private. Primary metric: activated, retained paying accounts and qualified dedicated engagements.
